en: The Analysis of the Monastic Rules (Bhikkhu-vibhaṅga), First Part.
1.5 Section on Origination (Samuṭṭhānavāra) Regarding the offenses for one who engages in sexual intercourse: by how many of the six origins of offenses do these offenses originate?
The offenses for one who engages in sexual intercourse originate from one of the six origins of offenses—namely, by one origin.
They originate from both body and mind, not from speech …pe….
Regarding the offense for one who, out of disrespect, voids excrement, urine, or spittle in water: of the six origins of offenses, by how many origins does it originate?
Regarding the offense for one who, out of disrespect, voids excrement, urine, or spittle in water: of the six origins of offenses, it originates by one origin.
It originates from both body and mind, not from speech.
The fifth section on origination is finished.
